title: Ust Claude
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Official announcement from Anthropic: Ust Claude
body: UST is collaborating with Anthropic to deploy Claude across physical AI applications, including industrial manufacturing and quality assurance. By integrating Claude's visual reasoning capabilities with assembly line cameras, the system detects micro-defects in real-time, reducing recalls and scrap rates. The partnership demonstrates the growing integration of large language models into physical automation. This solution enables factories to deploy intelligent visual inspection agents that adapt to new product designs quickly without requiring extensive manual retraining cycles. UST plans to expand this visual inspection system globally.
